title: SNES
description: Super Nintendo games on the iDrive (the Snes9x emulator, in its libretro form snes9x2005; for non-commercial use only). Comes with one small free game, Pad Test. Your own .sfc and .smc files, zipped or not, come from a phone (Add games shows a code to scan; needs the SNES game loader from this source), from a folder "snes" on a USB stick, or are copied to the head unit. Played with an Xbox pad on a cable (needs the SNES game loader); the iDrive controller steers the menus and is enough for a slow game. A short main menu; the list of games, Add games and the settings as tabs on one drawn screen; the game pixel for pixel on the whole screen; BACK returns to the menu and saves. Sound on the car's speakers, with the SNES game loader (it takes the place of the radio while a game runs; a setting switches it off)
